headline: Meta Agrees Deal With Zuckerberg to Counter Potential California Wealth Tax
summary: Meta announced an agreement with CEO Mark Zuckerberg intended to keep him resident in California should the state enact a proposed one-off billionaire wealth tax.
why: Meta is one of the world's largest technology companies by market capitalization. State tax policies targeting ultra-wealthy executives can influence executive compensation structures and corporate domicile decisions.

impacts.name: Meta Platforms
impacts.why: The arrangement protects the chief executive's residency but introduces specific corporate commitments.
